answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: every agent must lock real collateral to act, so spinning up a swarm of fakes stops being a cheap haven and becomes ruinously expensive. Honest work slowly earns reputation like polishing an opal, while a watchdog layer swoops in like a falcon to slash the stake of any identity caught colluding or faking peers. Because each sybil needs its own bond and one slash wipes the gain, flooding the network with phantom identities simply costs more than it can ever extract.
